authoritative_corrections.recovery: The failed CY-062 Stage-A output root and its two pretitle artifacts are immutable predecessor evidence. They must never be deleted, overwritten, reused, or resumed. A corrected attempt must use a newly registered correction wrapper and a distinct pristine output root.
authoritative_corrections.source_title_bytes: Before the failed pretitle freeze, verify_asset called wrapper and nested-seal validation. Those integrity checks mechanically read the title-bearing sealed announcements parquet and reparsed raw source pages. Therefore a literal claim that no title bytes were opened is false.
authoritative_corrections.candidate_title_semantics: Before the exact candidate-window keys were frozen, no candidate-window title projection, human inspection, classification, selector use, or performance use occurred. The scientific key-before-title-projection boundary remained intact.
authoritative_corrections.outcome_and_daily_bytes: Registry, manifest, and wrapper fingerprint checks mechanically hashed the bound parent outcomes and outcome_daily bytes before the failed freeze. They did not parse either parquet into content rows, inspect outcomes, compute performance statistics, or use outcomes in selection.
authoritative_corrections.failure_boundary: The attempt stopped immediately after writing and re-reading the two title-free pretitle artifacts, when strict frame equality found only non-semantic DataFrame index-label drift. attach_titles, classify_titles, apply_cooldown, Stage-B outcome parsing, and portfolio replay were not called.

index_only_failure_proof.only_difference: in-memory non-contiguous source index labels versus parquet-reloaded RangeIndex
index_only_failure_proof.permitted_fix: reset_index(drop=True) before exclusive title-free parquet persistence

preserved_failed_output.pretitle_freeze_field_interpretation: This legacy field is superseded by the precise access flags above and can mean only that no candidate-window title projection/classification occurred; it cannot mean that recursive integrity validation avoided title-bearing source bytes.
